title: Anticyclotomic Iwasawa theory of CM elliptic curves at ramified primes
summary: We propose an integral framework for the anticyclotomic Iwasawa theory of CM elliptic curves $E$ at primes $p$ ramified in the CM field. The $\varepsilon$-constants of the geometric specialisations of the associated $p$-adic conjugate symplectic self-dual deformation equidistribute between $\pm 1$ within every layer of the anticyclotomic tower, and none of the geometric specialisations are trianguline at $p$.
